description: This file defines the OA_Central class, providing utility methods for URL building and XML-RPC client creation within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Central
classes.description: A utility class for constructing URLs and XML-RPC clients based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Builds a URL string from configuration variables, considering port and protocol.

methods.name: getXmlRpcClient
methods.description: Creates and returns an OA_XML_RPC_Client object configured with protocol and port based on SSL availability.

methods.name: canUseSSL
methods.description: Checks if SSL extensions are available for secure communication.
